description: Every non-procedural runtime file under assets/models, assets/textures and assets/materials. Each entry points to a provenance record by id. The asset validator fails when a runtime file has no entry.

assets.notes: Parametric PBR presets derived from the style guide palette (style.md section 3); their textures are procedural surfaces generated in code (src/assets/include/rv/assets/surface_textures.hpp), no image files. Since I6 step 4 also the dark shells of cases and boxes standing on their side (MAT_Case_Jewel_Smoke, MAT_Case_Keep_Black, MAT_Case_Plastic_Dark, MAT_Cardboard_BigBox), original presets; since I6 step 6 the arcade cabinets' laminate, paints, lit mouldings and marquees and their screens (MAT_Cabinet_*, MAT_Molding_*, MAT_Marquee_*, MAT_Screen_Off, MAT_Screen_Idle, MAT_Screen_Arcade) and the handhelds' teal plastic (MAT_Plastic_Teal), original presets; since I5 step 3's review the secondary TV's charcoal plastic (MAT_Plastic_Charcoal), an original preset.

The CRT presets of the world's screens (I5 step 6, ADR-0016 section 7, specification section 9.6): neutral, consumer, arcade and monitor, each a set of the picture tube's effect values (src/assets/include/rv/assets/crt_presets.hpp), original values; no image files.

UI sans for the product screens (style.md section 17.3), loaded by rv::ui::UiSystem; since I3 step 5 also rasterized with stb_truetype for the generated collection labels' system name and year (rv::assets::FontFace, ADR-0011 section 5), loaded only when its SHA-256 matches this entry; the rasterized textures are derived data, never distributed as a font. Upstream fonts/ttf file, unmodified.

Bold weight of the UI sans; since I3 step 5 also rasterized with stb_truetype for the titles on the collection's spines and generated front labels (rv::assets::FontFace, ADR-0011 section 5), loaded only when its SHA-256 matches this entry; the rasterized textures are derived data, never distributed as a font. Upstream fonts/ttf file, unmodified.

The symbol: the picture tube with the neon R, amber and magenta for dark grounds, on its 64-unit grid. Original, made by scripts/branding.py from the logo's one geometry (docs/branding.md); regenerate, never edit by hand.

The icon's large design (40 px and up): the symbol over a charcoal glass, so that it reads on light and dark taskbars. Original, made by scripts/branding.py from the logo's one geometry (docs/branding.md); regenerate, never edit by hand.

The icon's design at 16 px, drawn on its pixel grid (straight sides, strokes of whole pixels); 20 to 32 px follow the same rule. Original, made by scripts/branding.py from the logo's one geometry (docs/branding.md); regenerate, never edit by hand.

The wordmark: 'retroverse' as tube centerlines 8 units thick, 'retro' amber and 'verse' magenta, for dark grounds. Original, made by scripts/branding.py from the logo's one geometry (docs/branding.md); regenerate, never edit by hand.

The horizontal lockup, symbol and wordmark with tubes of one thickness, for dark grounds. Original, made by scripts/branding.py from the logo's one geometry (docs/branding.md); regenerate, never edit by hand.
The horizontal lockup in walnut and plum, for light grounds. Original, made by scripts/branding.py from the logo's one geometry (docs/branding.md); regenerate, never edit by hand.
The stacked lockup, the symbol over the wordmark, for dark grounds. Original, made by scripts/branding.py from the logo's one geometry (docs/branding.md); regenerate, never edit by hand.

The executable's icon, 16 to 256 px (rv_set_windows_icon, cmake/TargetDefaults.cmake): 16 to 32 px drawn on their pixel grid, 40 px and up the large design; deployed with the assets but read only by the resource compiler. Original, made by scripts/branding.py from the logo's one geometry (docs/branding.md); regenerate, never edit by hand.
